label: resume-mi8937-experimental-candidate
command: import pathlib,json,datetime; p=pathlib.Path("config/project-requirements.json"); d=json.loads(p.read_text()); d["donor_selection"]["mi8937"]="User explicitly permits trying the Mi8937 community port as an experimental candidate; platform name is not an OS version"; p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n"); p=pathlib.Path("artifacts/experimental/status.json"); d=json.loads(p.read_text()); d.update({"updated_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"status":"experimental-candidate-unbooted","publication_paused":False,"reason":"User permits trying Mi8937; verify actual framework independently and do not claim official device support","next_candidate":"Continue existing Mi8937 experiment; spes remains alternative"}); p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+"\n"); print("Resumed preserved Mi8937 experimental candidate after explicit user steering.")
